gloss: to pass through, to go through, to elapse

definitions.gloss: to pass through, to go via, to go through (a process or place)
definitions.explanation: To go through a particular route, process, stage, or intermediary on the way to a destination or result.
For time to pass or elapse. Often used in the pattern 〜を経て (after going through, having passed through).

examples.japanese: ⟦{審査|しんさ}→審査：08375_shinsa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{経|へ}て⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I passed through the screening and was accepted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{経|へ}て⟦{広島|ひろしま}→広島：28985_hiroshima⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: I headed to Hiroshima via Osaka.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{経|へ}て、ようやく⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: After going through long discussions, a conclusion was finally reached.
I still remember even after ten years have passed.

⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧50⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{経|へ}て、⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧⟦{復興|ふっこう}した→復興する：25381_fukkousuru⟧。

notes:
Ichidan (ru-verb): {経|へ}る → {経|へ}ない → {経|へ}た → {経|へ}て.

USAGE:
The te-form {経|へ}て is extremely common, meaning "after going through" or "via." It is used both for physical routes (⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{経|へ}て) and abstract processes (⟦{審査|しんさ}→審査：08375_shinsa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{経|へ}て). For the time sense, it is often literary or formal.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧: to pass through (physical movement)
- ⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: to pass, to go by (of time)
- ⟦{経過|けいか}する→経過する：21996_keikasuru⟧: to elapse, to pass (noun/verb-suru form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{経|へ}て: via, after going through
- {時|とき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{経|へ}る: time passes
- ⟦{年月|ねんげつ}→年月：00310_nengetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{経|へ}る: years pass
- ⟦{過程|かてい}→過程：02621_katei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{経|へ}る: go through a process
